name: Lightfall-TS-TW

frames.best_why: The streak fountain fills the frame evenly with a bright blue core at the top centre.

tagline: Pale streaks pour down a violet tunnel that arcs away from the centre.
summary: A violet-blue backdrop of curved white streaks falling from a bright patch at the top centre, like light through a tunnel. The streaks shift and twinkle while the whole scene flows slowly outward.
appearance: A deep violet-to-navy gradient fills the frame, brightest at the top middle where a soft blue-white glow sits. Hundreds of thin pale streaks run down and fan outward in curved lines, denser near the edges.
behaviour: Streaks fall and curve away from the centre, with parallel trails sliding at different lengths so the pattern churns. Some flicker in brightness; the pointer adds a faint tinted glow wherever it rests.
search_phrases: rain of glowing lines behind a hero
use_when: A launch page or banner needs a full-bleed dramatic backdrop with motion but no content.
avoid_when: Pages with lots of text on top: the busy streaks and bright core lower contrast everywhere.
customise: Streak count, width, length, palette, background colour, speed, glow, density, twinkle and zoom are props. Changing the tunnel shape means editing the shader.
weight_why: A full-screen fragment shader with a per-pixel ray loop runs every frame.

a11y.note: Decorative shader only. It has no motion preference check, so the continuous animation always runs.

polish_why: Depth and motion read well; the bright core washes out the top of the frame.
title: Lightfall
